latest.title: Numbers for when on-scene ROSC stops happening
latest.finding: Probability of subsequent on-scene ROSC 6.97% at 10 min and 0.50% at 20 min after EMS contact; favourable neurological outcome (CPC 1–2 at 1 month) in 50.0% of patients <75 and 20.5% of those ≥75 with on-scene ROSC at or after 10 min

latest.title: Airway assistant training halved sim intubation time
latest.finding: Median intubation time 53 s (IQR 19) trained vs 102.5 s (IQR 36) untrained, p = 0.009, very large effect size (Cohen's d = 1.86); no oesophageal intubations in either group

latest.title: Modelled Response Times for Police and Fire Brigade Co-Dispatch
latest.finding: Median first-unit response 9.81 min with EMS alone vs 5.45 min with police added, 7.36 min with fire added, 5.41 min with triple dispatch (paired median gain 4.34 min); locations reached within 10 min rose from 51.1% to 94.6%

latest.title: Social support buffers the violence-to-burnout pathway
latest.finding: Workplace violence exposure associated with burnout indirectly through post-traumatic stress symptoms; social support moderated the violence–PTSS (p = 0.002) and violence–burnout (p = 0.015) associations; resilience findings did not survive correction
